thread:
jordan: FYI opened a docs PR to add a small section about hosting offline bundles behind an internal S3 mirror and a brief apt/yum repo sync example for air-gapped sites. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5078

jordan: Also included: a compact PKCS11 example, and a note about HSM slot numbering differences. Didn't add Windows firewall yet.

lee: Thanks. Quick note: our internal build process signs bundles with cosign, can you add verification example for cosign and the sha256 file?

jordan: Good call. I'll add both. Draft snippet: 
```bash
# verify cosign signature and checksum
cosign verify-blob --key cosign.pub redwood-offline-bundle.tar.gz.sig redwood-offline-bundle.tar.gz 
sha256sum -c redwood-offline-bundle.tar.gz.sha256 || (echo "bad checksum" && exit 1)
```

priya: For the apt repo sync, suggest using `reposync` + `createrepo_c` in the offline mirror example. Also call out apt `Release` and `InRelease` files so apt can verify signatures.

lee: On the PKCS11 bit, we ran into CKR_GENERAL_ERROR when the HSM vendor uses higher slot numbers. Recommend adding a troubleshooting note: "If you see CKR_GENERAL_ERROR or CKR_SLOT_ID_INVALID, try enumerating with `pkcs11-tool --list-slots --module /opt/vendor/lib.so` and use the displayed slot ID."

jordan: I'll add that. Draft PKCS11 install call: 
```bash
redwoodctl install --profile edge-light \\n  --airgap /opt/mirror/offline-bundle.tar.gz \\n  --kms pkcs11 \\n  --pkcs11-module /opt/vendor/lib.so \\n  --pkcs11-slot 2 \\n  --pkcs11-pin-file /etc/redwood/pkcs11-pin
```

priya: Small UX nit: the example kube-profile should lower memory to 128Mi for the `edge-lite` container to fit tiny lab boxes.

jordan: Will change mem request to 128Mi.

docs-bot: PR #5078 lint: dead link detected -> ./install/offline.md#mirror-config.

jordan: I moved that anchor; will restore the mirror-config heading and add an example `s3-sync` systemd timer: 
```ini
[Unit]
Description=Sync offline mirror from S3

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/s3-sync-mirror --src s3://internal-bundles --dest /var/lib/redwood/offline
```

lee: Also add a line about S3 pre-signed URLs expiring: "If you host bundles via presigned URLs, ensure the release process updates consumers or use long-lived internal objects with access controls."

priya: Windows firewall snippet suggestion: 
```powershell
# allow outbound to KMS cluster range
New-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName "Redwood KMS" -Direction Outbound -RemoteAddress 10.10.0.0/24 -Protocol TCP -RemotePort 443 -Action Allow
```

jordan: Added that and a note about corporate proxy appliances that rewrite TLS/SNI causing KMS handshake failures.

sre-bot: Staging doc preview deploy: 7/8 checks passed, apt repo example triggered a link-check warning for `createrepo_c` manpage.

jordan: I'll point to the upstream package page instead of the manpage anchor to avoid flakiness.

lee: One more: mention `/etc/resolv.conf` symlink issues on distros that use resolvconf - suggest the connector config `dns` fallback or adding `--dns 1.1.1.1` to install docs.

jordan: Added both notes. Final checklist: 
- add cosign + sha256 verification (done)
- add pkcs11 troubleshoot note + enumeration example (done)
- lower kube-profile memory to 128Mi (done)
- add s3-sync systemd timer and presigned URL note (done)
- Windows firewall snippet and SNI proxy note (done)
- fix dead link to mirror-config (done)

docs-bot: PR #5078 updated, lint re-run queued.

sre-bot: Staging preview: 8/8 checks green. Ready for review.

jordan: Thanks all, assigning @lee and @priya for final approval. Hoping to merge tomorrow AM and publish a small docs patch release.

lee: Will review first thing.

priya: LGTM pending small wording tweak on the apt signature paragraph.

jordan: Will push wording tweak now. Merge when approvals done. :rocket:
